ns2:section.sectionText: Off-campus section. Enrollment is through Academic Outreach. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Location: Puerto Rican Cultural Center, 2700-2704 W. Haddon St., Chicago. The course is built around participation in the 5th Annual Community as Intellectual Space (CIS) symposium, "Critical Pedagogy: Community Building as Curriculum", June 12-14, 2009 [590 CIO students attending the CIS symposium are entitled to a reduced registration fee of $60, which includes the opening dinner.] Class meetings: June 12-20 as follows: Friday, June 12, 9:00 a.m. to noon and 2:00 to 9:00 p.m.; Saturday, June 13, 8:30 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. (with lunch, dinner, and coffee breaks); Sunday, June 14, 8:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.; Saturday, June 20, 1:00 to 4:00 p.m.). Includes readings, initial class session, Symposium participation, structured experiential learning & final paper (due 6/21) that describes and reflects on in- and out-of-class activities. Contact the instructor for further details or question about the course (abishop@illinois.edu). See section description at http://lis.illinois.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
